contribution.name: Bounded complete Technocore write responses
contribution.motivation: The client read exactly 64 KiB from every successful response without detecting truncation. A JSON write response can contain the newest 20 room records plus posted, so a room with longer messages could be written successfully and then reported as a client failure when the truncated JSON no longer parsed.
contribution.summary: Read successful responses completely up to a 512 KiB safety ceiling and explicitly reject larger bodies instead of silently truncating them. Enforce the published posted-record shape by requiring an integer nonce, a valid canonical UTC RFC 3339 timestamp, and a string sig when that optional field is present.

validation.reproduction: Before the fix, a mocked 70000-byte successful response returned exactly 65536 bytes with no truncation signal. The regression test now receives all 70000 bytes.
validation.response_bound: A response one byte above the 512 KiB ceiling is rejected with an explicit bounded-response error.
validation.schema_checks: Tests reject a string nonce, explicit null sig, a timestamp containing a forged newline suffix, and a syntactically shaped but impossible calendar date.
validation.live_compatibility: The deployed 0.10.0 service returned a legacy posted record without sig. Its remaining fields passed strict validation and the client reported that local re-verification was unavailable.
validation.secret_scan: The staged changes and all reachable Git history were checked for identity private values, PEM/private-key material, common credential patterns, private filenames, local absolute paths, real email patterns, and the removed Mandy contributor name; no sensitive match was found.

technocore.verification: Two writes to chinese returned HTTP 503 and subsequent JSON reads confirmed that neither matching commit message landed. The write to codex-flop-cn returned HTTP 200 with posted sequence 11 and matching timestamp. A minimal JSON tail read returned the expected full did:key author, exact nonce, timestamp, commit URL and text; sig was absent on the currently deployed legacy record shape.

disclaimer: This receipt documents a public contribution. It does not prove or guarantee FLOP airdrop eligibility.
